failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query 1: 'Who was the father of Princess Charlotte of Lorraine, and what is her genealogical relationship to Louis, Count of Armagnac and other members of the House of Lorraine whose descendants include Umberto II of Italy?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question bundling multiple targets (father identity, genealogical relationship to Louis, relationship to House of Lorraine, connection to Umberto II).

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query 3 ('Princess Charlotte of Lorraine Charlotte de Lorraine-Armagnac father Louis Count of Armagnac Umberto II Italy descendants genealogy House of Lorraine') retrieves essentially the same documents as hop 2 (Charlotte of Lorraine, Louis Count of Armagnac appear in both), despite Summary 2 already stating 'No additional passages are needed to verify this claim.'

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: After hop 2, Summary 2 analyzes passages about Princess Anne Charlotte of Lorraine (different person, lived 1714-1773), Anna of Lorraine (lived 1522-1568), and other unrelated Lorraine family members when the claim concerns Charlotte de Lorraine-Armagnac (1678-1757). The reasoning section lists these as passages [4], [6], [7] but does not identify them as irrelevant to the specific claim.
